policy: Official U.S. House Clerk EVS XML (2026 unpadded rolls 253-292) and U.S. Senate LIS roll-call XML (119th Congress 2nd session votes 202-231) for WA members. House match is name-id==bioguide. Senate match is last name + state. vote_cast is the exact official text. Votes are never invented. Vacant CA-14 is skipped. No Ballotpedia. No scores.
